<!-- Generated by pnpm docs:generate. -->

[WORKFLOW.md の設定方法](/reference/workflow/)とあわせて使用します。`*` は任意のキーです。「必須」は型定義での指定要否です。`runner.close_on_complete` のようにパーサーが既定値を補う項目や、別項目との組み合わせが必要な項目があります。

## 基本設定

| 設定キー | 定義型 | 指定 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | `1` | 必須 |
| `timezone` | `string` | 省略可 |

## `database`

| 設定キー | 定義型 | 指定 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | `オブジェクト` | 省略可 |
| `database.stop` | `string` | 親の指定時に必須 |
| `database.reset` | `オブジェクト` | 親の指定時に必須 |
| `database.reset.snapshot` | `string` | 親の指定時に必須 |
| `database.reset.seed` | `string` | 親の指定時に必須 |

## 検証条件

実際の検証コードから抽出した条件と診断です。[設定方法](/reference/workflow/)に主な条件と実行時の契約をまとめています。

<details>
<summary>パーサーの検証条件</summary>

````typescript
need(match, 'YAML front matter がありません')
need(object(raw), '設定はオブジェクトです')
need(!prompts[sections[i]!], `プロンプト重複: ${sections[i]}`)
need(raw.version === 1, 'version は 1')
need(raw.timezone === undefined || typeof raw.timezone === 'string', 'timezone は IANA タイムゾーン名です')
need(object(raw.tracker) && raw.tracker.kind === 'github' && object(raw.tracker.query), 'tracker が不正')
need(Object.values(raw.tracker.query).every((x) => typeof x === 'string'), 'tracker.query は文字列のマップ')
need(strings(raw.tracker.exclude_labels), 'exclude_labels は配列')
need(raw.tracker.pr_limit === undefined || positive(raw.tracker.pr_limit), 'tracker.pr_limit は正の整数です')
need(raw.tracker.hold_labels === undefined || strings(raw.tracker.hold_labels), 'hold_labels は配列')
need(object(raw.stage_store) && raw.stage_store.kind === 'dirs' && typeof raw.stage_store.initial === 'string' && object(raw.stage_store.commands), 'stage_store が不正')
need(typeof raw.stage_store.rejected === 'string' && raw.stage_store.rejected.trim() && raw.stage_store.rejected !== raw.stage_store.initial, 'stage_store.rejected は initial と異なる空でない段階名です')
need((raw.tracker.hold_labels === undefined) === (raw.stage_store.held === undefined), 'tracker.hold_labels と stage_store.held はセットで指定してください')
need(typeof raw.stage_store.held === 'string' && raw.stage_store.held.trim() && ![raw.stage_store.initial, raw.stage_store.rejected].includes(raw.stage_store.held), 'stage_store.held は initial・rejected と異なる空でない段階名です')
need(strings(raw.stage_store.order) && raw.stage_store.order.length > 0, 'stage_store.order は段階名の空でない配列です')
need(raw.stage_store.order.every((name) => name.trim() === name && !!name && !/[\\/\r\n\t]/.test(name)), 'stage_store.order の段階名は空白・改行・パスを含めず指定してください')
need(new Set(raw.stage_store.order).size === raw.stage_store.order.length, 'stage_store.order の段階名が重複しています')
need(typeof raw.stage_store.commands[k] === 'string', `stage_store.commands.${k}`)
need(object(raw.workspace) && raw.workspace.kind === 'herdr' && object(raw.workspace.commands), 'workspace が不正')
need(typeof raw.workspace.commands[k] === 'string', `workspace.commands.${k}`)
need(object(raw.runner) && raw.runner.kind === 'herdr', 'runner が不正')
need(raw.runner.commands === undefined || (object(raw.runner.commands) && !Object.keys(raw.runner.commands).length), 'runner.commands（start / start_main）は廃止しました。agent は flow-<Issue番号> タブで起動します')
need(raw.runner.close_on_complete === undefined || typeof raw.runner.close_on_complete === 'boolean', 'runner.close_on_complete は真偽値です')
need(Object.values(commands).every((v) => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length > 0), `${group}.commands は空でない文字列のマップです`)
need(object(raw.notifier) && raw.notifier.kind === 'command' && (raw.notifier.command == null || typeof raw.notifier.command === 'string'), 'notifier が不正')
need(object(raw.concurrency) && positive(raw.concurrency.global) && object(raw.concurrency.per_step) && Object.values(raw.concurrency.per_step).every(positive), 'concurrency は正の整数')
need(object(raw.retry) && positive(raw.retry.max_attempts) && Array.isArray(raw.retry.backoff_ms) && raw.retry.backoff_ms.length && raw.retry.backoff_ms.every((x) => typeof x === 'number' && Number.isFinite(x) && x >= 0), 'retry が不正')
need(positive(raw.stall_ms), 'stall_ms は正の整数')
need(object(raw.locks) && Array.isArray(raw.locks.slots) && raw.locks.slots.every(positive) && new Set(raw.locks.slots).size === raw.locks.slots.length && object(raw.locks.resources), 'locks が不正')
need(/^[\w-]+$/.test(k) && object(v) && v.kind === 'rw', `資源が不正: ${k}`)
need(object(raw.gates) && Object.values(raw.gates).every((x) => x === 'auto' || x === 'manual'), 'gates が不正')
need(object(raw.database) && typeof raw.database.stop === 'string' && !!raw.database.stop.trim() && object(raw.database.reset) && [raw.database.reset.snapshot, raw.database.reset.seed].every( (v) => typeof v === 'string' && !!v.trim() ), 'database は stop と reset.snapshot / reset.seed のコマンドを指定してください')
need(object(raw.vars) && Object.values(raw.vars).every((x) => typeof x === 'string' || typeof x === 'number') && typeof raw.vars.main === 'string' && path.isAbsolute(raw.vars.main), 'vars.main は絶対パス')
need(object(raw.base) && typeof raw.base.resolve === 'string' && raw.base.resolve.trim(), 'base.resolve が必要です')
need(raw.gates.base_changed === 'manual', 'base_changed は選択肢が必要なため manual にしてください')
need(object(raw.steps) && Object.keys(raw.steps).length, 'steps がありません')
need(/^[\w-]+$/.test(name) && object(value), `step が不正: ${name}`)
need(step.db_reset === undefined || typeof step.db_reset === 'boolean', `${name}: db_reset は真偽値`)
need(raw.database !== undefined && !!step.agent && !!step.workspace && step.workspace !== 'none' && step.locks?.includes('db:shared') && 'db_reset' in raw.gates, `${name}: db_reset には database・worktree の agent・db:shared ロック・db_reset gate が必要です`)
need(typeof step.when_stage === 'string' || step.when_pr_merged === true, `${name}: 起動条件が必要`)
need([step.agent, step.remote, step.action].filter(Boolean).length === 1, `${name}: agent/remote/action のいずれか1つ`)
need(step.when_stage !== raw.stage_store.rejected, `${name}: stage_store.rejected を when_stage に指定できません`)
need(raw.stage_store.held === undefined || step.when_stage !== raw.stage_store.held, `${name}: stage_store.held を when_stage に指定できません`)
need(['claude', 'codex'].includes(step.agent.kind) && typeof step.agent.name === 'string' && step.agent.name.startsWith('flow-') && !!prompts[name], `${name}: agent または prompt が不正`)
need(object(step.workspace) && (step.workspace.pr === true || (typeof step.workspace.branch === 'string' && typeof step.workspace.from_base === 'string')), `${name}: workspace が不正`)
need(gate in raw.gates, `gate 未定義: ${gate}`)
need(step.skippable === undefined || typeof step.skippable === 'boolean', `${name}: skippable は真偽値`)
need(!!step.gate_before, `${name}: skippable には gate_before が必要`)
need(step.remote.kind === 'copilot' && typeof step.remote.assign === 'string', `${name}: remote が不正`)
need(step.remote.transport === undefined || ['rest', 'graphql'].includes(step.remote.transport), `${name}: remote.transport が不正`)
need(step.remote.login === undefined || (typeof step.remote.login === 'string' && !!step.remote.login.trim()), `${name}: remote.login が不正`)
need(step.remote.agent_assignment === undefined || (object(step.remote.agent_assignment) && Object.values(step.remote.agent_assignment).every((v) => typeof v === 'string')), `${name}: agent_assignment は文字列のマップ`)
need(step.remote.assign.includes('{assign_body}'), `${name}: assign に {assign_body} が必要`)
need(['timeline', 'review_requested', 'not_draft'].includes(step.remote.done_when), `${name}: remote.done_when が不正`)
need(strings(step.remote.authors), `${name}: remote.authors が不正`)
need(object(step.action) && (step.action.remove_workspaces === true || typeof step.action.command === 'string') && (step.action.remove_workspaces === undefined || typeof step.action.remove_workspaces === 'boolean') && (step.action.command === undefined || typeof step.action.command === 'string'), `${name}: action が不正`)
need(object(step.done_when) && (!step.done_when.files || strings(step.done_when.files)) && (!step.done_when.stage_in || strings(step.done_when.stage_in)), `${name}: done_when が不正`)
need(file.length > 0 && !path.isAbsolute(file) && !file.split(/[\\/]/).includes('..'), `${name}: done_when.files は Issue 内の相対パスです`)
need(object(transition) && (!transition.set_stage || typeof transition.set_stage === 'string') && (transition.stop === undefined || typeof transition.stop === 'boolean') && (transition.remove_workspaces === undefined || (strings(transition.remove_workspaces) && transition.remove_workspaces.every((branch: string) => branch.length > 0))), `${name}: 遷移が不正`)
need(strings(step.locks), `${name}: locks が不正`)
need(lock === 'slot' || (/^([\w-]+):(shared|exclusive)$/.test(lock) && lock.split(':')[0]! in raw.locks.resources), `未知の lock: ${lock}`)
need(object(step.on_approve) && [step.on_approve.command, step.on_approve.prompt].filter((x) => typeof x === 'string').length === 1, `${name}: on_approve は command/prompt のいずれか`)
need(object(raw.remote) && strings(raw.remote.authors) && ['timeline', 'review_requested', 'not_draft'].includes(String(raw.remote.done_when)), 'remote 設定が不正')
need(object(raw.remote.ng_action) && typeof raw.remote.ng_action.command === 'string' && typeof raw.remote.ng_action.set_stage === 'string' && (raw.remote.ng_action.choice === undefined || (typeof raw.remote.ng_action.choice === 'string' && ['copilot', 'self', 'stop'].includes(raw.remote.ng_action.choice))), 'remote.ng_action が不正')
need(object(raw.remote) && object(raw.remote.ng_action) && ['copilot', 'self', 'stop'].includes(String(raw.remote.ng_action.choice)), 'ng_action:auto は remote.ng_action.choice が必要です')
need(Object.values(raw.steps).every( (s) => !(s as Step).workspace || (s as Step).workspace === 'none' || 'adopt_workspace' in (raw.gates as Record<string, unknown>) ), 'workspace を使う場合は adopt_workspace gate を定義してください')
need(new Set(stages).size === stages.length, 'when_stage が重複しています')
need(Object.values(raw.steps).filter((s) => (s as Step).when_pr_merged).length <= 1, 'when_pr_merged は1つまで')
need(Object.keys(raw.tracker.query).every((k) => ['assignee', 'state', 'label', 'search', 'milestone', 'author'].includes(k) ), 'tracker.query に未対応の条件があります')
need(Object.hasOwn(known, root!) && (rest.length === 0 || (rest.length === 1 && known[root!]!.includes(rest[0]!))), `未定義の変数: ${m[1]}`)
````

</details>
